title: Correct time expression
description: Essential: The final expression for the acceleration time t must be correctly derived and match the reference solution, t = (qB²R²/(2mU) - 1) * πm/(qB).

title: Correct maximum thickness
description: Essential: The final expression for the maximum plate thickness d_m must be correctly derived and match the reference solution, d_m = 2(√(R² - 2mU/(qB²)) - √(R² - 4mU/(qB²))).

title: Correct maximum radius
description: Essential: The final expression for the maximum magnetic field radius R_m must be correctly derived and match the reference solution, R_m = R + (2mER/(qB²R - mE)) sin(α/2).

title: Kinetic energy and acceleration steps
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the final kinetic energy at P (from Lorentz force) to the number of acceleration cycles n via the work-energy theorem: nqU = (qBR)²/(2m).

title: Geometry of deflector plates
description: Important: For parts (2) and (3), the solution must correctly apply geometric relations (e.g., difference in orbital radii for d_m, and circular arc geometry for R_m).

title: Forces in the deflector
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must correctly analyze the combined Lorentz and electric forces in the deflector to find the new orbital radius around point Q.

title: Period of circular motion
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly state the period T = 2πm/(qB) and correctly relate the total time t to (n-1) half-periods.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly handling the relative directions of the electric and magnetic forces in the deflector, leading to a wrong sign in the net force expression.

title: Algebraic or substitution mistake
description: Pitfall: Making an error in algebraic manipulation or substitution when deriving the final expressions for t, d_m, or R_m from the core physics equations.
